name: csscheck
description: Playwright verification that the cssgen compat build renders identically to the modern theme. Start the app (default http://localhost:8088/, override with CSSCHECK_URL), then: npm run check. First time: npm install && npx playwright install chromium firefox.

scripts.check: node clamp.mjs && node flexgap.mjs && node panel2.mjs && node logical.mjs && node textbox.mjs
